intro: The Paramount marries timeless style with unbeatable comfort. Its mid-century design, supportive seating, and soft armrests create a cosy corner, inviting you to unwind in peace.

features.title: Built to last for years
features.text: Made with a solid wood frame, this sofa is durable enough to handle daily use and still look great—perfect for active households or anyone who loves lasting quality.

features.title: A backrest that supports where it matters
features.text: The carefully designed mid-backrest provides gentle support to your shoulders and spine, so you can sit comfortably without strain, whether for work or relaxation.

features.title: Wide armrests for relaxed feel
features.text: The Paramount features soft armrests with a distinctive wooden element that adds character to it. The wide, heightened armrests make it easy to settle in for long conversations, movie nights, or just a little downtime at the end of your day.

features.title: Soft foam for plush comfort
features.text: Equipped with soft foam cushioning, this sofa provides excellent support for long hours of lounging, reading, or simply relaxing.

features.title: Timeless design that suits any space
features.text: With its symmetrical lines and minimalist silhouette, this sofa blends contemporary style with timeless appeal, fitting beautifully into any décor.

features.title: Sturdy legs that add a touch of charm
features.text: The elevated conical legs not only keep the sofa stable but also add a light, airy feel to your room, making it easy to clean underneath.
